name: My Stories
summary: Shopify app that adds Instagram-style video stories, shoppable clips and a lead form to product pages, with a free plan for 10 videos.
best_for: small Shopify stores with product videos that want Instagram-style stories, shoppable clips and a lead form without custom code
skip_if: your store is not on Shopify, you want more than 100 videos without paying $45 a month, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The free plan carries a watermark and stops at 10 videos. Lead capture is capped at 20 a month on the $14 plan, so a store that gets real traffic moves to $45 quickly. Plan names differ between the vendor site and the Shopify listing. We have not installed the app, so the lead sync and speed claims are the vendor's own.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on getmystories.com/pricing, US dollars) Beginner: $0, up to 10 uploaded videos, unlimited views, shoppable videos, watermark. Advanced: $14 a month, up to 100 videos, up to 20 leads a month, analytics, no watermark. Pro: $45 a month, unlimited videos and leads. 7-day free trial on paid plans. The Shopify listing shows yearly prices of $140 and $450. We have not installed the app.

schema_offer.description: Advanced, per month, 7-day free trial; Beginner free with watermark; Pro $45 per month. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

free_plan_evidence: (read 2026-11-17 on getmystories.com/pricing, US dollars) Beginner: $0, up to 10 uploaded videos, unlimited views, shoppable videos, watermark.

compare_with.name: Essential Cart Drawer
compare_with.why: Both are Shopify apps that change what shoppers see on the storefront, but My Stories is about video and lead capture while a cart drawer is about checkout. Compare which gap in your store is costing more.
